analysis: Previous round shows a clear pattern: operators on the [95,158] volume/order-flow and [29,95] momentum/volatility subspaces with moderate windows (10-15) produced the highest screen effects (lead_lag_beta 0.0041, path_efficiency 0.0039, vol_price_corr 0.0051), while short-window KBar [0,9] and very short windows (5-8) generally underperformed or failed validation (negative full effect). The best screen_effect came from vol_price_corr[95,158] w12 (0.0051) and lead_lag_beta[95,158] w10 (0.0041), yet their full-validation effect was negative — suggesting these single-operator kernels are too low-rank/too aligned and overfit the screen fold. Strategy for round 1: (a) evolve the top screen performers by combining them with complementary [29,95] and [9,29] channels to raise effective rank and decorrelate from 11^T/B; (b) build 3-5 channel symbolic predicates that mix volume/order-flow time-ops (std, autocorr_1, hurst_proxy, path_efficiency) with momentum slope/ema_diff and cross-interactions (corr, ratio, lead_lag) to enrich rank; (c) avoid tiny windows (>=8) and avoid pure [0,9] KBar-only descriptors; (d) include a few composite mix/concat blends of the strongest single operators (vol_price_corr, lead_lag_beta, path_efficiency) with orthogonal [29,95] operators to hedge the negative full-validation effect. All proposals use >=3 diverse weakly correlated channels or >=2 mixed parts to satisfy the rank gate.

proposals.name: VolFlowMomentumRankMix
proposals.rationale: Combine volume-price correlation (screen winner 0.0051) with momentum slope and path efficiency to add orthogonal rank dimensions and reduce collapse toward the global shrinkage kernel.

proposals.name: LeadLagBetaVolHurst
proposals.rationale: Evolve lead_lag_beta[95,158] winner by adding hurst_proxy on [29,95] and semivar asymmetry to diversify rank while preserving order-flow lead-lag beta signal.

proposals.name: PathEffVolPriceLeadLag
proposals.rationale: Blend path_efficiency[9,29] with vol_price_corr[95,158] and a lead_lag_corr cross-channel to decorrelate from ones-kernel and lift effective rank.

proposals.name: OrderFlowMomentumHurstTriple
proposals.rationale: Triple of order-flow autocorr, momentum hurst, and vol-price ratio across three distinct subspaces to maximize effective rank and hedge single-operator overfit.

proposals.name: VolPriceBetaMomentumSlope
proposals.rationale: Use beta interaction between volume std and momentum slope plus a path-efficiency channel to capture cross-sectional dispersion in flow-adjusted momentum.

proposals.name: RegimeFlowAsymMomentum
proposals.rationale: Capture regime transitions via semivar asymmetry on volume plus momentum hurst and vol-price lead-lag to span multiple weakly correlated rank directions.

proposals.name: FlowVolRatioTrendQspread
proposals.rationale: Ratio interaction of volume std to momentum mean plus trend-slope and iqr channels to enrich rank while keeping order-flow dominance.

proposals.name: MomentumFlowCorrHalfTriple
proposals.rationale: Use corr_half on momentum paired with flow autocorr and a hurst channel to capture half-window stability of flow-momentum coupling.

proposals.name: VolPriceCorrBetaPathEff
proposals.rationale: Evolve vol_price_corr winner by adding a beta interaction and path efficiency to raise effective rank and cross-sectional spread.

proposals.name: FlowLeadLagMomentumHurst
proposals.rationale: Lead-lag correlation between flow and momentum with hurst proxy on flow to isolate persistent order-flow regimes.

proposals.name: MomentumTrendFlowRatio
proposals.rationale: Ratio of momentum trend slope to flow volatility plus a q_spread and ema_diff channel to span rank across momentum and volume subspaces.

proposals.name: VolHurstMomentumBetaFlow
proposals.rationale: Beta of volume hurst on momentum slope plus a flow autocorr channel to capture persistent-flow-adjusted momentum ranking.

proposals.name: OrderFlowAsymMomentumCorr
proposals.rationale: Semivar asymmetry on flow with a momentum-flow corr channel and hurst proxy to diversify rank and reduce ones-alignment.

proposals.name: PathEffFlowBetaHurst
proposals.rationale: Evolve path_efficiency[9,29] winner by pairing with flow beta and hurst proxy on [29,95] to raise rank while keeping path-efficiency signal.

proposals.name: FlowVolMomentumQspreadTriple
proposals.rationale: Combine flow std-to-momentum ratio, q_spread flow dispersion, and momentum slope to span three weakly correlated rank directions.

proposals.name: MomentumHurstFlowLeadLagBeta
proposals.rationale: Momentum hurst with flow lead-lag correlation and beta to capture cross-sectional persistence of flow-momentum coupling.

proposals.name: VolPriceCorrHurstSemivarMix
proposals.rationale: Mix vol-price corr with hurst proxy and semivar asymmetry across flow and momentum to maximize rank while hedging single-operator sign instability.

proposals.name: FlowMomentumRatioHurstQspread
proposals.rationale: Ratio of flow std to momentum slope combined with hurst and q_spread to span order-flow and momentum rank directions.

proposals.name: PathEffFlowMomentumBeta
proposals.rationale: Path efficiency on momentum with flow beta and autocorr channels to capture flow-adjusted momentum path quality.

proposals.name: SemivarFlowMomentumHurstLeadLag
proposals.rationale: Semivar flow asymmetry with momentum hurst and lead-lag corr to capture regime-conditional flow-momentum alignment.

proposals.name: MomentumFlowCorrQspread
proposals.rationale: Correlation interaction of momentum mean with flow std plus q_spread and path efficiency to diversify rank.

proposals.name: VolPriceCorrOperator
proposals.rationale: Refine vol_price_corr operator with a mid window (12) on the volume subspace, the strongest screen performer, to test full-validation stability at slightly different scale.

proposals.name: LeadLagBetaOperator
proposals.rationale: Refine lead_lag_beta operator with window 11 on volume subspace to test whether slightly longer lookback improves full-validation effect.

proposals.name: PathEfficiencyOperator
proposals.rationale: Refine path_efficiency operator on momentum subspace with window 13 to test mid-window stability of the screen winner.

proposals.name: FlowMomentumCompositeMix
proposals.rationale: Convex mix of vol_price_corr, lead_lag_beta, and path_efficiency kernels to hedge single-operator negative full-validation effect and raise effective rank.

proposals.name: FlowMomentumHurstCompositeConcat
proposals.rationale: Concat of vol_price_corr and hurst_vr operators to span order-flow correlation and momentum persistence rank directions.

proposals.name: SymbolicFlowMomentumComposite
proposals.rationale: Mix a 4-channel symbolic flow-momentum predicate with a path_efficiency operator to combine rank-rich symbolic structure with a stable single operator.
